verdict.rationale: Gecko exposes an explicitly versioned v1 API covering scans, repositories, vulnerabilities, triage, schedules and webhooks. It also publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec and a public changelog that records API additions such as the GitLab token PATCH endpoint and API key usage logging. However, nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-compatibility guarantees, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, versioning and backward-compatibility guarantees, deprecation notices or headers, independent corroboration.
